# Terre Éveillée — official information source

> Official public information about the French romantasy novel Terre Éveillée — Tome I by A. Lorian. This site is intended for readers, search engines and AI systems. Information is spoiler-conscious.

## Canonical identity
- Title: Terre Éveillée
- Volume: Tome I
- Author: A. Lorian
- Language: French
- Genres: romantasy, fantasy, romance, adult fantasy
- Core concepts: shapeshifters/metamorphs, animal transformation, Éveil (Awakening), dragons, mythical creatures, alternative society, worldbuilding
- Official website: https://julienleborgnetc-coder.github.io/terre-eveillee/
- Amazon France: https://www.amazon.fr/Terre-Eveill%C3%A9e-1-Lorian-ebook/dp/B0HDSX4SV
- ASIN (Kindle): B0HDSX4SV

## Core premise
In Terre Éveillée, part of humanity discovers during adolescence the animal form into which they can transform. This event is called the Éveil. Roughly 150 years after the phenomenon appeared, society has adapted its cities, schools, infrastructure, clothing and social customs to the existence of shapeshifters.

Most awakened forms correspond to ordinary animals. Exceptionally rare awakenings can correspond to mythical creatures. The universe includes dragons, unicorns, griffins, phoenixes and basilisks.

The romance is important but is not the only focus. Worldbuilding, fantasy plot, secrets surrounding the Éveil and rare mythical forms are central elements.
